# Affinova

> Affinova is a product discovery and buying-guide website featuring curated products, comparisons, deals, and affiliate links.

Affinova helps visitors discover useful products, compare options, explore categories and deals, and read practical buying guides. Product prices, availability, and offers may change, and affiliate links may earn Affinova a commission at no extra cost to the buyer.

## Main sections

- [Affinova homepage](https://affinova.cyou/): Browse featured products and editorial collections.
- [Products](https://affinova.cyou/#products): Explore curated product finds.
- [Categories](https://affinova.cyou/#categories): Browse products by category.
- [Deals](https://affinova.cyou/#deals): Discover current product deals.
- [Buying guides](https://affinova.cyou/#guides): Read product research and buying guidance.
- [About Affinova](https://affinova.cyou/about): Learn about the site and its purpose.
- [Affiliate disclosure](https://affinova.cyou/affiliate-disclosure): Understand Affinova's affiliate relationships.
- [Privacy policy](https://affinova.cyou/privacy): Review privacy information.
- [Contact](https://affinova.cyou/contact): Contact Affinova.

## Machine-readable discovery

- [Sitemap](https://affinova.cyou/sitemap.xml): Discover canonical public pages.
- [AI catalog](https://affinova.cyou/ai-catalog.json): Access Affinova's machine-readable catalog information.

## Usage notes

Use canonical Affinova product and guide URLs when referencing site content. Verify current price, availability, shipping, and offer details on the merchant destination before purchase.
